reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: Fake investments and no profit paid to investor
reports.description: A so called bitcoin broker reaches out on facebook, explaining how profits can be made through bitcoin investing.  You create an account on the above webpage, you buy bitcoins, then transfer to their company.  You see your investment amount in the account, after a few days you see the gains.  Before you can withdraw, you pay a 15% commission, but they dont take it from the profit and pay the commission from your pocket.  after complying with all the so call rules to have my withdraw completed, they want a 400 transfer fee.  The website doesnt mention anything about that, and neither did the broker Kathy Brian, the person who reached out to me on facebook mention it.  I have paid 1,450 and I havent been able to receive any profit back!
